title: Oracle Price Aggregation
description: Computes the aggregate price a decentralized oracle network would publish from a set of individual submissions, under four mechanism-named aggregation rules: median-filtered confidence-weighted mean, stake-weighted median on the frequency convention, three-vote confidence median, and plain median with an f-of-n readout. Supports an optional prev_print_hash citing the prior print of the same pair, which turns a series of same-pair prints into a walkable chain; omitting it reproduces the unlinked-print output byte for byte. Every price, weight, confidence, timestamp and submitter id is supplied and asserted, never fetched (zero-egress). Simulates the aggregation step only, does not model the commit-reveal phase, and never claims any real network did or would publish this number. A submitter id may be supplied as a sha256-salted@1 commitment (SPEC.md §25) to withhold the identifier while keeping the aggregation bound to it. Not a price feed and not a market-data source.

mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes an oracle aggregate price from supplied submissions under a named aggregation mechanism, optionally citing the prior print of the same pair. Aggregation step only, zero egress, every submission supplied and asserted.

source: DERIV-WF-ORACLE-1, WU-authored (D-class new-node shard) -- builds DERIV-WORKFLOWS-BUILD-SPEC.md §6 (AT-06) including the §4 prev_print_hash wiring. output_schema derived by running the kernel's own compute() directly against the 7 vectors in chaingraph/kernels/fixtures/art-560-oracle-price-aggregation.fixtures.json (no compute_proof exists yet, proving deferred to the async GPU queue). prev_print_hash and chain_position are emitted CONDITIONALLY, present only when the optional lineage field is supplied, which is what keeps an omitting call byte-identical to a no-wiring artifact. Not run through scripts/generate-node-manifest.mjs -- that generator reads the assembled chaingraph.json and this is a shard-only D-class WU that never touches the monolith (board/RIDER-KERNEL.md).
